about:
# MGSSounds
WoW AddOn | Plays Metal Gear Solid sounds at specific times

Uses the command `/mgssounds`

Here are the various commands:
```
/mgssounds help
/mgssounds disable
/mgssounds combat
/mgssounds death
/mgssounds tradeopen
/mgssounds tradeshow
/mgssounds tradestop
/mgssounds lootopen
/mgssounds lootcollect
/mgssounds whisper
```

Note: Commands other than help will toggle the sound on/off. If you want to view the current settings, try `/dump MGSSounds_Vars`.

## Supported Clients

- **TBC Anniversary** (Interface 20506) via `MGSSounds.toc`
- **WoW Forever** (Interface 16001) via `MGSSounds_Camelot.toc`

On WoW Forever the combat log is closed to addons, so the killing blow sound uses the `PARTY_KILL` event instead. Everything else works the same on both clients.

## Creating a Release

Releases are built by CurseForge automatic packaging (see `.pkgmeta`):

1. Add an entry to `CHANGELOG.md`
2. Push a tag such as `v1.7.0` (tags containing "alpha" or "beta" become test builds)
3. CurseForge packages the `MGSSounds` folder, fills in `## Version` from the tag, and sets game versions from each TOC's Interface line

## Tests

Offline checks (Node.js required): `cd tests && npm install && npm test`

releases.name: MGSSounds v1.7.0: WoW Forever support
releases.notes:
### Added
- **WoW Forever support**: new `MGSSounds_Camelot.toc` (Interface 16001) loads on the WoW Forever client; TBC Anniversary keeps using `MGSSounds.toc` (Interface 20506)
- **Killing blow sound on WoW Forever**: Forever closes the combat log to addons, so killing blows there come from the `PARTY_KILL` event instead of `COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED`
  - PvP Only checks for a player GUID (`Player-...`) on Forever
  - If the game hides who got the kill (secret values), no sound plays rather than erroring

### Changed
- `COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED` is only registered on clients that allow it (TBC Anniversary); it is never registered on Forever, where doing so gets the addon blocked
- Events are registered defensively, so an event a client doesn't know can't stop the addon from loading
- The eating/drinking sound listens to the player's casts only (`RegisterUnitEvent`) and ignores secret spell IDs
- Options panel works without the classic-only templates: falls back to `UICheckButtonTemplate` (with its own tooltip) and `UISliderTemplate`, and to a button that cycles audio channels if the dropdown menu is unavailable
- TBC Anniversary behavior is unchanged

### Technical
- CurseForge automatic packaging: added `.pkgmeta`; both TOCs use `## Version: @project-version@` and `## X-Curse-Project-ID: 1326306`
- Added offline smoke tests in `tests/` (mocked classic and Forever clients; not shipped in the package)

**Install:** download `MGSSounds-v1.7.0.zip` and extract it into your `Interface\AddOns` folder, or get it from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1326306). One zip works on both WoW Forever and TBC Anniversary.

releases.name: MGSSounds v1.6.1
releases.notes:
## [v1.6.1] - 2026-09-07

### Added
- **Killing Blow PvP Only Option**: New "PvP Only" sub-checkbox under "Killing Blow Sound" in the options panel
  - When enabled, the killing blow sound only plays when the target killed is a player character
  - Checks `COMBATLOG_OBJECT_TYPE_PLAYER` in the destination unit flags of the `PARTY_KILL` event
  - Disabled by default (sound plays for all killing blows)

### Changed
- **Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary Support**: Interface version bumped to 20505
- Options panel registration and the `/mgssounds config` command now detect the available API at runtime
  - Uses `Settings.RegisterCanvasLayoutCategory` / `Settings.OpenToCategory` when present
  - Falls back to `InterfaceOptions_AddCategory` / `InterfaceOptionsFrame_OpenToCategory` on older clients
  - Prints a friendly message instead of erroring if neither API is available

### Technical
- Added `killingblow_pvponly` saved variable to both global and character-specific settings (defaults to false)
- Options panel stores the registered Settings category so it can be opened by ID
- Killing blow debounce cancels any in-flight timer before starting a new one
